If you don’t believe God wants you well, then you will not have the faith it takes to get a healing from the Lord. You are not supposed to ask God to heal you, but Jesus said to talk to your mountain (Matthew 21:21-22) (problem), and if you have faith, it will be cured. So don’t talk to God about your sickness, but talk to the sickness about God, and miracles will happen, if you have faith, and don’t doubt (unbelief) (Matthew 13:58). Thank you Lord for giving us the healing power of our words.
